**Overview:**  
Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company providing home‑care services for the elderly (“Perkhidmatan jagaan warga emas di rumah”) in Kedah, Malaysia. The firm was incorporated on 3 December 1995 and remains active, with the sole shareholder being Director 1 who owns 100 % of the equity. Financial statements for 2022‑2024 show a recent shift from losses to a profit in 2024, with an unqualified audit opinion each year. No litigation as defendant is recorded.
